hackathon.name: Mantle Turing Test Hackathon 2026 - Phase II AI Awakening

delivery_mode_reason: DoraHacks-style online submission prioritizes demo URL, repo URL, and video; build one combined pitch+demo video and keep deck as backup.

frontend.dependency_policy: frontend deps install with @latest/unversioned targets unless an override_reason is recorded
frontend.primary_ui_library: shadcn/ui primitives adapted into custom proof-console shell
frontend.non_tailwind_visual_signature: split-screen receipt bench with quote ledgers, evaluator rule stamps, proof-hash perforation marks, and binary payout ribbons
frontend.hero_composition: full-width workbench: agents left, task and evaluator center, receipt/proof rail right
frontend.visual_differentiation_note: white/ink/mint proof-console surfaces with amber failure states, monospace hash strips, and receipt textures instead of purple crypto dashboards

qr_mobile_access.desktop_parity_plan: desktop keeps agent, evaluator, receipt, and proof rail visible at 1920x1200
